            Full job description

            Senior Software Engineer

            Organisation/Entity: Transport For NSW
            Job category: Information & Communication Technology
            Job location: Macquarie Park, NSW, AU, 2113
            Job reference number: 107286
            Employment type: Permanent Full-Time
            Salary range: $158393.0-$177399.0

            You see the big picture, you’ve always worked on a grand scale, and now you’re ready to re-focus on grand impact.


            Your innovative mindset is key to creating solutions to complex problems. Our systems drive our organisational success and underpin every journey our customers take. This is your opportunity to be part of an expert team who build and refine seamless technology experiences.


            In this role, you'll:



            As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop and maintain scalable, secure and high-performing integration and software solutions across cloud and on-premises environments. You will work with modern technologies including Azure integration services, APIs, event-driven architectures and automation frameworks to deliver mission-critical solutions that support business outcomes and enterprise technology standards.

            For more information on this position and business unit, view the role description and information pack.


            About you



            You are an experienced Software Engineer with a strong background in cloud-native development, systems integration and API-led architectures. You bring hands-on experience with Azure technologies, CI/CD pipelines and software development using languages such as Python or PowerShell, and thrive in collaborative environments where you can mentor others, solve complex technical challenges and contribute to high-quality engineering outcomes.

            Who we are



            Transport for NSW provides a safe, integrated, and efficient transport system. We connect people, communities and industry every day.

            Join us


            Our workforce is as diverse as the community we serve. If you’d like further information on our inclusion and diversity initiatives, visit Transport careers.


            Flexible work options may be available. Learn more via Flexible work options and policy


            Apply today


            Applications close 11:59 PM Wednesday 7 October, 2026.


            For more information about this role, please contact ISABELLA.LUKAC@TRANSPORT.NSW.GOV.AU.


            Aboriginal people and people living with disability are supported throughout the recruitment process and at work, and we encourage you to apply. Visit Supporting Aboriginal People or Supporting People with Disability for more information or speak to your talent team member to arrange any adjustments to how you interact with us.


            Learn more about how to apply via Our recruitment process | Transport for NSW
